synapse:
  postgres:
    host: your-db-host.tld
    port: 5432
    user: your-synapse-user
    password:
      value: your-synapse-user-password
    database: your-synapse-database-name
    sslMode: prefer

matrixAuthenticationService:
  postgres:
    host: your-db-host.tld
    port: 5432
    user: your-matrix-auth-service-user
    password:
      value: your-matrix-auth-service-user-password
    database: your-matrix-auth-service-database-name
    sslMode: prefer

# source_fragments: init-secrets-minimal.yaml postgres-minimal.yaml server-name.yaml synapse-minimal.yaml synapse-redis-valkey-secrets-in-helm.yaml synapse-redis-valkey.yaml synapse-some-workers-running.yaml
# DO NOT EDIT DIRECTLY. Edit the fragment files to add / modify / remove values

# initSecrets, postgres don't have any required properties to be set and defaults to enabled
deploymentMarkers:
  enabled: false
elementAdmin:
  enabled: false
elementWeb:
  enabled: false
matrixAuthenticationService:
  enabled: false
matrixRTC:
  enabled: false
serverName: ess.localhost
synapse:
  ingress:
    host: synapse.ess.localhost
  redisOrValkey:
    host: "external-redis-or-valkey.example.com"
    password:
      value: "test-redis-valkey-password"
    port: 6379
  workers:
    appservice:
      enabled: true
    client-reader:
      enabled: true
    event-persister:
      enabled: true
    federation-reader:
      enabled: true
wellKnownDelegation:
  enabled: false

# source_fragments: deployment-markers-minimal.yaml deployment-markers-pytest-extras.yaml init-secrets-minimal.yaml init-secrets-pytest-extras.yaml matrix-authentication-service-minimal.yaml matrix-authentication-service-pytest-extras.yaml postgres-minimal.yaml server-name.yaml synapse-minimal.yaml synapse-pytest-base-extras.yaml
# DO NOT EDIT DIRECTLY. Edit the fragment files to add / modify / remove values

deploymentMarkers:
  annotations:
    has-no-service-monitor: "true"
  podSecurityContext:
    runAsGroup: 0
elementAdmin:
  enabled: false
elementWeb:
  enabled: false
haproxy:
  podSecurityContext:
    runAsGroup: 0
  replicas: 2
initSecrets:
  annotations:
    has-no-service-monitor: "true"
  podSecurityContext:
    runAsGroup: 0
matrixAuthenticationService:
  additional:
    000-pytest-admin:
      configSecret: "{{ $.Release.Name }}-pytest-admin"
      configSecretKey: "admin.yaml"
  extraEnv:
    - name: DEBUG_RENDERING
      value: "1"
  ingress:
    host: mas.{{ $.Values.serverName }}
    tlsSecret: "{{ $.Release.Name }}-mas-web-tls"
  podSecurityContext:
    runAsGroup: 0
  replicas: 2
  syn2mas:
    extraEnv:
      - name: DEBUG_RENDERING
        value: "1"
matrixRTC:
  enabled: false
postgres:
  podSecurityContext:
    runAsGroup: 0
serverName: ess.localhost
synapse:
  additional:
    00-login-rate-limits.yaml:
      config: |
        # Playwright tests log in many users from the same IP. The default
        # limits are too low for that.
        rc_login:
          address:
            per_second: 10
            burst_count: 1000
  checkConfigHook:
    annotations:
      has-no-service-monitor: "true"
  extraArgs:
    # Validate that any Synapse config that has a <foo>_path equivalent uses it
    - --no-secrets-in-config
  extraEnv:
    - name: DEBUG_RENDERING
      value: "1"
  ingress:
    host: synapse.{{ $.Values.serverName }}
    tlsSecret: "{{ $.Release.Name }}-synapse-web-tls"
  podSecurityContext:
    runAsGroup: 0
wellKnownDelegation:
  enabled: false
